prompt: Should the Codex hook activation spike (T-01) be treated as a hard gate before Phase 2 (design/investigation kinds), rather than as informational? The v1 design deliberately assumes hooks do NOT work under `codex exec`, so a negative result changes nothing — but a positive result would let ToolUseInterception be declared and make PATH shims defence-in-depth rather than the sole guardrail carrier.

Rewriting those contracts to be file-based would unblock them and would arguably make triage MORE reliable than it is on Claude today, but that is a separate project.
